disclosure.title: Before you turn this on
disclosure.why: This uses the accessibility permission to ask you once when you open an app you chose, at the time you set.
disclosure.sees: Only the name of the app that comes to the front.
disclosure.notSees: Screen content, anything you type, or apps you did not choose.
disclosure.where: The names of apps you chose, your check-in results, and device info, to improve the service and for statistics. The messages you write are also used to improve the service. We never read or send screen content or anything you type.
disclosure.path: Where to turn it on: Accessibility → Installed apps (or Downloaded apps) → App check-in
disclosure.stillOff: It's still off. You need to turn it on in Settings.

new.intercept: Ask when I open an app
new.interceptBody: When you open an app you chose, we ask once in your words.
new.interceptExample: Open a game during work hours → “Back to work?”
new.check: Remind me if I don't open it
new.checkBody: If you haven't opened the app by a set time, we remind you.
new.checkExample: Haven't opened your journal by 9 PM → one reminder
new.appQ: Which apps should we ask about?
new.appSub: You can pick more than one.
new.whenSub: We ask if you open the apps during this time.
new.whenSame: Start and end are the same

newCheck.timeSub: If you haven't opened it by then, we remind you once.
newCheck.timeLine: If you haven't opened {{app}} by {{time}}, we remind you once.
newCheck.messageSub: The reminder shows this line as you wrote it.

rule.message_sub: This line shows biggest when you open the app.
rule.name: Rule name
rule.preview_hint: It's just a picture — nothing is recorded

stats.title: Last 7 days
stats.promptNote: How many times the check screen showed and what you chose.
stats.checkNote: ✓ means you opened the app that day.

settings.title: Settings
settings.diag_sub: Once a day: error counts, device info and usage stats.
settings.wipe_sub: The copy on our server stays.
settings.wipe_body: Rules, history and unsent changes will be removed from this phone. This can't be undone.
settings.wipe_note: The copy on our server stays. To delete it too, tell us via Contact us.
